integrity: Seven complete embedded files including executable, self-contained standard-library checks. Finite diagnostics are not a proof; the global inequality and local asymptotics are analytically established in RESULT.md.
scientific_limitations: Only central sections of finite right circular solid cylinders; no classification of all interior stationary directions, translated sections, noncircular cylinders, or robustness. Classical prior coverage beyond the material inspected remains a priority risk.
title: Sharp global and local perimeter transitions for central circular-cylinder sections
